texts.collection.title: Our Collection
texts.collection.intro: Hand-made pieces, grouped by who and what they're for. Tap any item to open it.
texts.shop.title: Our Shop
texts.shop.intro: AAA is a luxury fashion and art brand creating unique custom-designed pieces that speak individuality, creativity and timeless style.
texts.shop.customBody: Have an idea, a sketch, a photo? Upload your image and our studio will hand-craft it into a one-of-a-kind wearable piece. Every AAA custom order is made-to-order, just for you.
texts.create.title: Design it yourself.
texts.create.intro: Your page in the workbook: pick a base, click any part of the drawing and paint it, drag the AAA mark wherever it belongs, choose fabric, size and cuts. The studio hand-makes exactly what you draft.
texts.about.title: One pair of hands,
texts.about.body1: AAA started exactly the way this website looks: as a workbook. A place where sketches, fabric swatches and half-ideas pile up until one of them refuses to stay on the page.
texts.about.body2: Everything in the shop is made by hand in my studio — painted sneakers sealed and flexed for real wear, hoodies rebuilt with patches and embroidery, one-off objects that are equal parts furniture and inside joke.
texts.about.body3: Nothing is mass-produced. When a piece sells, it's gone — the page turns, and the book moves on. If you want something handmade, made in small numbers, you're in the right place.
texts.about.quote: Souls are rare. Pretty faces are everywhere.
texts.about.process1: It starts as a sketch in this book — a line, a joke, a feeling.
texts.about.process2: Then the hunt: the right blank, the right fabric, the right thread.
texts.about.process3: Paint, stitch, fray, seal — every mark made by hand, no two alike.
texts.about.process4: Photographed, numbered and filed here. Then it's yours.
texts.contact.title: Write to the studio
texts.contact.body: Commissions, custom pieces, sizing questions, or just to say the Mona Lisa Jordans are a lot — every message lands on this desk and gets a reply from the artist.
texts.contact.note: often replies within a day or two — usually with sketches

products.name: Baroque Bloom Cap
products.tagline: Hand-embroidered cobalt scrollwork on cotton.
products.description: A one-off dad cap embroidered by hand with cobalt baroque florals that wrap from the crown to the brim. The signature mark is stitched in burnt orange across the front panel. No two are identical.

products.name: Reaching Hands Cap
products.tagline: Painted hands meet a reworked patterned ground.
products.description: Patterned canvas reimagined with two hand-painted reaching hands — a nod to the Creation of Adam — set against a tonal brown jacquard. A studio rework, finished and sealed by hand.

products.name: Bronx Stitch Low
products.tagline: Pinstripes and baseball-thread topstitching on a low-top.
products.description: A low-top silhouette customized with navy pinstripes, a hand-laid baseball-stitch in orange thread, and a Bronx-blue side stripe. A love letter to the ballpark, built to be worn.

products.name: Jade Reptile High
products.tagline: Embossed jade scales on a high-top silhouette.
products.description: A high-top silhouette wrapped in hand-finished jade-green reptilian texture across the overlays and side stripe, contrasted by clean white leather. Statement pair, finished in the studio.

products.name: Plushie Throne
products.tagline: A sculptural chair upholstered in reclaimed plush toys.
products.description: A functional art object: a mid-century shell chair re-skinned entirely in salvaged plush toys, each hand-placed and secured. Part seat, part sculpture — a single edition piece.

products.name: Kilim Wrap Skirt
products.tagline: Woven diamond kilim with braided trim and side tie.
products.description: A wrap mini cut from a woven kilim tapestry in rust, ochre and teal, edged in hand-braided cord and finished with a side tie. Pairs with the Kilim Halter for a full set.

products.name: Kilim Halter
products.tagline: Deep-V halter in matching kilim weave.
products.description: A plunging halter in the same rust-and-teal kilim weave, with rope ties at the neck and waist. Designed to pair with the Kilim Wrap Skirt or stand on its own.

products.name: Buffalo Plaid Cropped Hoodie
products.tagline: Cropped flannel hoodie with crochet-stitched mark.
products.description: A boxy cropped hoodie in soft buffalo-plaid flannel, with the brand mark worked across the kangaroo pocket in raised crochet. Relaxed sleeves, dropped shoulder.

products.name: Ecru Frayed Knit Halter
products.tagline: Ruffled, frayed-edge knit with bow ties.
products.description: A delicate ecru knit halter with frayed ruffle edges and a front bow tie. The tiny signature is embroidered at the hem in burnt orange. Soft, textured, romantic.

products.name: Coastal Stripe Halter
products.tagline: Painterly blue stripe on airy gauze.
products.description: A breezy halter in hand-painted blue-and-white stripe gauze, with neck and waist ties and a frayed hem. Signed at the lower front. Made for warm evenings.

products.name: Midnight Bow Cami
products.tagline: Tie-dyed black satin cami with empire bow.
products.description: A slip-style cami in cloud tie-dyed black satin, with adjustable straps and an empire-line satin bow. The signature is printed small at the hem. Quietly dramatic.

products.name: Bloom Sherpa Pullover
products.tagline: Painted-bloom sherpa with oversized back mark.
products.description: A plush sherpa pullover in sand, splashed with charcoal, apricot and lilac blooms. The full signature mark sits large across the back; a small mark at the front shoulder. Heavyweight and warm.

products.name: Floral Mosaic Hoodie
products.tagline: Sun-faded oxblood with a hand-laid floral mosaic patch.
products.description: A heavyweight oversized hoodie washed to a faded oxblood, with a raw-edged floral mosaic patch appliqued at the chest and crude cross-stitching at the collar and sleeves. No print — every mark is sewn.

products.name: Skate Flannel Hybrid Hoodie
products.tagline: Half hoodie, half flannel — spliced into one.
products.description: A cream oversized hoodie spliced at the hem into a green tartan flannel shirt, finished with a plaid camp collar and a screen-printed skate-star pocket graphic. A patchwork hybrid, one continuous piece.

products.name: Bloom Sticker Hoodie
products.tagline: Black ground, blue bloom, full sticker-collage sleeve.
products.description: A black oversized hoodie with a painted blue smiley-bloom on the chest and one full sleeve collaged in sticker-style graphics. The back carries scattered patches and a hand-drawn signature.

products.name: Daisy Sleeve Sweatshirt
products.tagline: A column of daisies down each sleeve.
products.description: A black oversized crewneck with the signature waveform at the chest and a printed daisy running the full length of each sleeve. Soft, heavyweight, quietly graphic.

products.name: Purple & Gold Tribute Sweatshirt
products.tagline: Court purple & gold with hand-laced sleeves.
products.description: A black oversized crewneck carrying a purple-and-gold court-tribute print at the chest, finished with hand-laced gold and purple cross-stitching down the sleeves and a woven hem tab.

products.name: Souls Are Rare Hoodie
products.tagline: Royal blue, embroidered in molten orange thread.
products.description: A royal-blue hoodie hand-embroidered front and back in orange and cream thread — scattered scribbles on the front, the mantra “Souls are rare, pretty faces are everywhere” arched across the back.

products.name: Frayed Pocket Sweatshirt
products.tagline: A ruptured shearling pocket on raw cream.
products.description: A cream oversized crewneck with a hand-frayed shearling pocket torn open over a charcoal panel, plus charcoal elbow patches. Deconstructed, tactile, one-of-one in feel.

products.name: Swordsman Hoodie
products.tagline: Anime patchwork with katakana sleeves.
products.description: An off-white hoodie with a raw-edged anime swordsman patch at the chest, a matching crest on the back, and black katakana panels running down both sleeves. Finished with a green hand-stitched mark.

products.name: “At The Gym” Acid-Wash Hoodie
products.tagline: Acid-washed olive with a glow-print confession.
products.description: An acid-washed olive hoodie with a soft glow-print waveform at the chest and the back line “I’m in a good place right now. Not emotionally. I’m just at the gym.” Worn-in from the first wear.

products.name: “Just Start” Sweatshirt
products.tagline: Ransom-note typography on washed espresso.
products.description: A washed espresso crewneck brushed with the painted waveform on the front and a cut-and-paste ransom-note message on the back: “You will never be ready. Just start.” Scattered stitch marks throughout.

products.name: Rainbow Child Hoodie
products.tagline: Sky-washed grey with a surreal cloud print.
products.description: A cloud-washed grey hoodie printed all over with a soft sky, finished with a surreal cherub-and-rainbow graphic on the back and a tangerine waveform above it.

products.name: Bubble Hoodie
products.tagline: Iridescent soap bubbles drifting over jet black.
products.description: A jet-black oversized hoodie scattered front, back and sleeves with painterly iridescent soap bubbles and tiny sparkles, anchored by the clean AAA waveform. Understated until the light hits it.

products.name: Straw-Hat Crew Hoodie
products.tagline: Sunflower yellow with an embroidered jolly crest.
products.description: A sunflower-yellow hoodie with an embroidered straw-hat skull crest at the chest and bold black katakana sleeve panels joined by red contrast stitching. Loud, clean, collectible.

products.name: Clay Court Tracksuit
products.tagline: Two-piece half-zip in oxblood, court-print back.
products.description: A heavyweight oxblood half-zip and jogger set, with an embroidered waveform at the chest and a clay-court print across the back. A complete two-piece — top and bottoms together.

products.name: Blanket-Stitch Tracksuit
products.tagline: Oxblood half-zip ringed in hand blanket-stitch.
products.description: An oxblood half-zip and jogger set hand-finished with a sunflower blanket-stitch yoke and a small scrawled mark on the thigh. Heavyweight fleece, made to wear as a set or split.

products.name: Hallows Gold-Foil Tee
products.tagline: Hand-gilded occult crest on washed black.
products.description: A washed-black heavyweight tee with a hand-gilded gold crest on the back — three medallions, the waveform and a reworked hallows symbol. Oversized, drapey, gallery-ready.

products.name: Patch Pocket Tee
products.tagline: Khaki box-tee with a denim logo pocket.
products.description: An oversized khaki box-tee with a denim chest pocket carrying the embroidered AAA frame, plus embroidered butterflies and tonal line-work on the sleeve. A runway piece, finished by hand.

products.name: Sculpt Bodysuit
products.tagline: Seamed compression unitard with an open back.
products.description: A second-skin short unitard in clay rust, paneled with sculpting seams and finished with an open keyhole back and the embroidered AAA mark. Studio-to-street performance wear.

products.name: Corduroy Distress Cap
products.tagline: Sand corduroy with a frayed denim AAA patch.
products.description: A sand-corduroy six-panel cap with a frayed powder-blue denim AAA patch, raw contrast stitching around the brim and tiny beaded charms at the side. Distressed and finished entirely by hand.

products.name: Zebra Brim Cap
products.tagline: Black crown, hand-painted zebra brim.
products.description: A washed-black six-panel cap with the AAA waveform stitched in natural thread across the front and a hand-painted zebra brim. Clean from the back, wild from the front.

products.name: Peacock Burlap Cap
products.tagline: Espresso cotton, raw burlap brim, peacock plume.
products.description: An espresso cap with a frayed raw-burlap brim, a burlap AAA patch hand-embroidered in brown, and a real peacock feather tucked at the side. Rustic, one-off, collectible.

products.name: Washed Line-Art Cap
products.tagline: Stone-washed dad cap with painted line-work.
products.description: A stone-washed grey unstructured dad cap with the embroidered AAA waveform and a single continuous painted line tracing across the crown and brim. Soft, low-profile, everyday.

products.name: Flame Low
products.tagline: Hand-painted flames over blaze orange.
products.description: A low-top silhouette hand-painted in blaze orange with airbrushed flames wrapping the side stripe, navy laces and a tonal AAA mark at the toe. Sealed and flexed for wear.

products.name: Cloud Low
products.tagline: Painted skies, candy-floss laces, glitter side stripe.
products.description: A pastel low-top silhouette hand-painted with a blue-sky-and-clouds upper, a candy-pink panel, fuzzy rope laces and a gold-glitter side stripe. Dreamy and one-of-one.

products.name: Marbled Flame Low
products.tagline: Tonal marble camo with red rope laces.
products.description: A low-top silhouette finished in a tonal sand marble-camo with a red side stripe, red rope laces and a small painted seal. Warm, textural, built to be worn.

products.name: Notebook Low
products.tagline: Lined-paper doodles on white leather.
products.description: A white low-top hand-drawn to look like lined notebook paper — blue rules, red-pen doodles, a scrawled AAA and blue laces. A sketchbook you can wear.

products.name: Jade Croc Mid
products.tagline: Embossed green croc overlays on white.
products.description: A mid-top silhouette wrapped in embossed jade-green crocodile texture across the overlays and side stripe, with a hand-drawn leaf-wing logo. Clean white leather underneath.

products.name: Neon Leaf High
products.tagline: Volt-green hits with a hand-drawn leaf wing.
products.description: A high-top silhouette in white leather with volt and lime-green panels, fuzzy neon laces, a green-line waveform on the sole and a hand-drawn leaf-wing logo. Electric and one-off.

products.name: Mona Lisa Mid
products.tagline: A Renaissance portrait painted across the panels.
products.description: A mid-top silhouette hand-painted with a Mona Lisa portrait wrapping the heel and quarter, olive-and-bronze leather, an olive side stripe and a gold AAA mark. A wearable old-master.

products.name: Shearling AAA Letters
products.tagline: Plush freestanding logo letters for the home.
products.description: A set of three freestanding AAA letters built up in cream shearling over a sculpted base — a soft, tactile logo object to lean against a wall or shelf. Sold as a three-letter set.
